name: sparkstone
description: By Love or by Fear (formerly Sparkstone) -- isometric action-adventure set in Pallimustus (HWFWM), Phaser 3 port. No build step: Phaser is vendored as a static ESM file (public/vendor/phaser.esm.min.js) and the game runs directly as browser-native ES modules. Serve the project root with any static file server, e.g. `python3 -m http.server 8000`, and open /index.html.
